title: Joe Oliver as a gentleman
summary: She remembers Joe Oliver as easy to get along with and gentle with a young girl.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Could you tell us anything more about Joe Oliver?

Well, that's all I ever knew about Joe because I was kind of halfway scared of his wife and him being such a gentleman, because I was really , you know. (Unintelligible) go on home to my brother or to my cousin's family.
Was he easy to get along with? Was he --
Joe was very easy to get along with.
No. To me, he wasn't because he knew I was a young girl and he always treated me like a young girl.
